title: Impeachment court announces new Sara Duterte trial schedule
summary: The break in the trial will give way to deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget

blocks.text: IMPEACHMENT COURT. Senator-judges prepare to ask former justices, appearing as amici curiae, about their opinion on the vote threshold debate, on September 16, 2026.
The break in the trial will give way to deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget
MANILA, Philippines — Amid its looming weeks-long break, the Senate impeachment court on Tuesday, October 13, issued the new schedule for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
The court is set to take a break until November 8 to give way to deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget.

Following the resumption of the trial, the defense counsel is expected to present its evidence on November 9, to counter the allegations of unexplained wealth against Duterte. – Rappler.com
